one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-11-18 to 2026-12-17 holds no AMAT print (Q1 FY27 reports mid-February). Scheduled read-throughs: Broadcom and Oracle results (early-mid December, AI capex tone), the December FOMC, SEMICON Japan with SEMI's year-end equipment forecast (mid-December), and Micron's FQ1 results around Dec 16-17 (memory capex for FY27, possibly just inside the window). Unscheduled: US export-control rules and data-center policy after the midterms (the Nov 5 selloff driver). The stock fell 54% from its June 30 high and bounced ~10% off the Nov 5 low; momentum is negative while reversal after a sharp drop argues the other way, so no directional call: lognormal at the stock's usual monthly vol (64% / 3.5 = 18.3%) around a median of $346 (slightly under the $349.23 close for the volatility drag).

fair_value.method: Driver build (WFE x AMAT share + AGS fleet index) valued at the horizon: P/E 19.7x on NTM GAAP EPS (~$17.3) = $340 (w 0.48), FCF yield 3.2% on NTM levered FCF = $455 (w 0.32), mid-cycle FY2029 EPS $16.15 x 19.7x = $318 (w 0.20); blend $372.66 = engine base.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM (FY2028-weighted) GAAP NOPAT / 785M horizon shares ~ $17.3 x 19.7x (peer median 24.95x shrunk to own 18.6x, k=0.8)

inputs_detail.derivation: Base CY26 = midpoint of Lam 'mid-150s' and TEL '~160' = 157. CY27 = 205: Lam >200, TEL >210, AMAT >+30% on 157 = >204; set at 205, below TEL, because Lam and AMAT both say cleanroom/component supply caps 2027 deliveries. CY28 = 213 (+4%): TSMC 2028 capex per brokers +10-17% over 2027 (MS 83->92, UBS 90->105), SK hynix books DRAM/HBM sold out through 2029 and Yongin ramps from 2027; offset by hyperscaler-capex durability risk (no hyperscaler has given 2027 numbers; political risk after the midterms), so well under the foundry path. CY29 = 200 (-6%): a digestion year after three up years, set as the mid-cycle year the horizon multiple can capitalise. Alternatives: TEL path (CY27 210) and a TSMC-capex-led CY28 (+12%) are listed in judgment_alternatives.
inputs_detail.variant_view: TEL >$210B CY27 and a TSMC-led CY28 +12% add 1.8-3.0%; a pause (downside case) cuts WFE 25%.

inputs_detail.derivation: Base 26,142/157,000 = 0.1665. FY27 0.165: China (where AMAT's mature-node share is high) falls from 27% of revenue to <25% per CFO Hill, and DRAM leads 2027 WFE growth (Lam, TEL), a segment where etch-heavy Lam gains more; partly offset by GAA/backside power and advanced packaging (+90% CY26) where AMAT is strongest. Held 0.165 in FY28 on the same mix, 0.166 in FY29 because a digestion year usually cuts memory and China tools first while leading-edge logic, AMAT's largest mix (58% of Q4 systems), holds. TrendForce (2026-10-07) adds that China is accelerating domestic equipment substitution. Variant: management's 'outperform WFE' claim (0.170+) adds ~3% to SS revenue.

FY27 38.5%: the Q4 FY26 exit run-rate (38.8%) on revenue ~8.4B a quarter, a level FY27 averages; held 38.5% in FY28 on similar volume (tool inflation offsets volume leverage); FY29 36.0% on revenue -6%: decremental margin ~70% on the lost revenue, back near the FY26 average.
TTM GAAP tax 1,460 / pretax 10,727 = 13.6%; Q1 FY27 guide includes a $0.04 one-off tax benefit, excluded; 14% sits within 1pt of the anchor.

Diluted shares 834 (FY24) -> 808 (FY25) = -3.1%; 808 -> 799 (FY26) = -1.1%. Q4 FY26 buyback $2.0B with $10.8B authorization left; at $6.5-7B a year of returns incl. ~$1.7B dividends, ~$5B of buybacks at $350-450 retires ~1.5% net of SBC dilution.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: NTM levered FCF (FY28 FCFF ~11.4B: NOPAT 13.7B + D&A 0.9B - capex 2.5B - NWC 0.6B) / 3.2% / 785M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: TTM D&A 527 / revenue 30,837 = 1.7%; rises as FY25-26 capex (EPIC center) depreciates.

FY26 capex = CFO 8,868 - FCF 6,196 = 2,672 = 7.8% of revenue (EPIC build); FY23-24 4.2-4.4% (1,106/26,517; 1,190/27,176); EPIC spend scaling to ~$5B total (24/7 Wall St) tapers, so the ratio steps down toward pre-EPIC levels.

FY26 CFO 8,868 vs GAAP NI 10,088 + D&A ~0.56B + SBC ~0.72B implies ~2.5B of working capital and non-cash gains absorbed on +6,078 revenue (~40%); part is non-cash investment gains, so 30% for inventory/receivables on growth.

Peer forward FCF yield = trailing (secfacts) x (1 + fwd EPS growth): LRCX 2.5% x 1.215 = 3.04%, KLAC 2.1% x 1.221 = 2.56%, ONTO 2.5% x 1.458 = 3.65%; median 3.04%. AMAT own = FY26 FCF 6,196 / (349.23 x 793.6M = 277.2B) = 2.24% x 1.45 = 3.24%. Shrunk: 3.04 x (3.24/3.04)^0.8 = 3.20%.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Mid-cycle normalized P/E: FY2029 (WFE -6% digestion year) EPS $16.15 x 19.7x

inputs_detail.derivation: Engine FY2029 NOPAT 12,318 / FY29 shares ~762.6M = $16.15 x 19.7x = $318; FY2029 is the digestion year (WFE -6%), used as mid-cycle EPS. Scenario custom_pct: downside 8,758/762.6 x 14.7 = $169 (-47%); upside 14,257/762.6 x 23.7 = $443 (+39%).

downside.story: P10: AI-capex pause. After the midterm data-center backlash and AI-lab 'pacing' talk, hyperscalers cut 2027-28 plans; memory makers slow Yongin/M15X tool-ins and TSMC trims 2028. WFE 25% below base each year (CY27 ~154, roughly flat on CY26), FY27 revenue ~34B (flat y/y despite the 11.1B Q1 guide), SS margin -4pt on lost absorption, AGS index -6%; P/E 14.7x, FCF yield 4.2%. Engine value $198.1.

base.story: Median: CY27 WFE $205B (+31%, between Lam >$200B and TEL >$210B, capped by cleanroom supply), CY28 +4%, CY29 -6%; AMAT systems share 16.5% as China falls below 25% of revenue; SS margin 38.5% then 36%; FY27 revenue $43.1B and GAAP EPS ~$16.4 (12% under consensus $18.75); exit P/E 19.7x and FCF yield 3.2% because the AI-capex durability discount the market applied in Oct-Nov largely persists.

upside.story: P90: WFE CY27 ~230 and CY28 ~239 as TSMC capex runs to UBS's $90B/$105B path, SK hynix's 2027 step-up and Yongin, and hyperscaler 2027 capex +50%; supply loosens; SS margin ~40.5%; P/E re-rates to 23.7x and FCF yield 2.8% as the AI-bubble discount fades. Engine value ~$511.

sbc_treatment.note: GAAP EBIT after SBC (FY25 SBC 668, F43); the share count falls only by buybacks net of grants (-1.5%/yr); AMAT's non-GAAP EPS also includes SBC, so consensus is on a near-identical basis.

reasoning: Industry lane. The rest of the chain says 2027 WFE grows ~30%: Lam (CY26 mid-150s, CY27 >$200B), Tokyo Electron (~$160B -> >$210B), AMAT's CEO (+30%+), TSMC capex $83-90B in 2027 per brokers, SK hynix's 2027 capex 'significantly' up with DRAM/HBM sold out to 2029, and hyperscalers guiding 2027 capex higher. Against that, AMAT and Lam both say cleanroom/components cap 2027 deliveries, TSMC's CEO is 'prudent' on 2027, and the Oct-Nov selloff (AMAT -54% from June high; midterm data-center politics, AI pacing talk, crowded positioning) is a sentiment shock, not a demand cut. Build: WFE 205/213/200 x share 16.5% (China falling, DRAM-led mix) + AGS fleet index +13/+10/+4% + Other; SS margin 38.5% from the Q4 exit, 36% in the digestion year. FY27 revenue $43.1B (+25%), GAAP EPS ~$16.4, 12% under consensus by design (rule 0c, supply caps). Q1 FY27 guide 11.1B checks against four FY26 quarters all inside, median +2.1% revenue beat. Valuation: P/E 19.7x via the k=0.8 shrink, FCF yield 3.2%, a mid-cycle FY29 leg (not driver-linked); research target (12m) $372.66 (+6.7%). P10 $198.1: WFE 25% lower (a 2027 pause), margin -4pt, multiple 14.7x; P90 $511.4. Left tail fatter, consistent with 64% realized vol. Peer set only 4; annual not quarterly set; SS margin alternative -5.7% is a card. Research was limited: several transcripts (Nasdaq, MarketBeat, Chartmill) were rate-limited or blocked; no option data was used.

model_inputs.structure_note: Annual driver-led set (not quarterly; see gap_note). Semicap build per playbook: Semiconductor Systems = calendar WFE ($B, outside forecasts from Lam, TEL, AMAT, TSMC/SK hynix capex) x AMAT systems share; AGS = FY26 base x installed-base index; Other (display/corporate) plain.
